root.label: Hogan Lovells and Cadwalader merger completed

events.label: Hogan Lovells and Cadwalader merger completed

slots.name: Combined lawyer count
slots.sentence: The combination of international law firm Hogan Lovells and New York-based Cadwalader, which created 3,100-lawyer Hogan Lovells Cadwalader on July 1, was the largest deal of the quarter.
